name: Rue
source:
"Apathetic, harsh, and painfully honest—it’s hard to not come to hate Rue.
He lives by always following the path of least resistance, accepting his job grudgingly. It’s hard to believe that he was a detective before The Incident—he doesn't look interested to investigate anything, despite the circumstances.

For now, all he wants are candies, or so you think by the way he gobbles them up, because who knows what’s going on behind that deadpan expression of his."
